text:
lia: quick design drop: new compact streaming row. two ideas: (A) Inline micro-toolbar with Stop + Regenerate, token delta shown as +N; (B) Floating toolbar that appears on hover with full token "sent / limit". screenshots attached. what's our gut?

kevin: lean inline micro-toolbar. floating on hover hides controls too often on touch.

maria: inline wins for discoverability. copy: keep visible label 'Regenerate' but show tooltip 'Generate again from same prompt'.

jon: token badge: avoid per-chunk jumps. propose showing delta (+45) during streaming and animate the number with 120ms ease; expand to full "sent / limit" on hover. For SR, only announce on focus.

tasha: infra: throttle UI token updates to 200ms and only emit telemetry at chunk boundaries. also sample long streams at 10% to save events.

lia: a11y: use aria-labels on icon buttons ("Stop generation (Esc)", "Regenerate reply"). streaming container should be aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false".

kevin: small behavior question: after Stop, keep partial text editable? I vote yes. allows quick edits + rerun.

maria: agree. when Regenerate is clicked, show a toast clarifying whether prompt was edited or not.

ux-bot: checklist: buttons have aria-labels, live region polite, token badge not auto-announcing, keyboard shortcuts documented.

lia: plan: implement inline micro-toolbar behind flag compact_stream_toolbar, throttle=200ms, tokenMode=delta. run 1-week canary 5% web. i'll file ticket with mocks + acceptance criteria. :white_check_mark:
